placeholder.email: Type an email and press Enter

help.name: Short label you'll see in the bots list.
help.description: Free text describing the topic — for your reference and future AI scoring.
help.schedule: How often the bot polls its sources for new articles. Your choice below converts to the technical 'cron' string automatically.
help.cron: Cron is a standard schedule format: minute hour day_of_month month day_of_week. Example: '0 9 * * 1-5' = weekday mornings at 9:00.
help.keywords: The bot will keep an article when its title or description contains at least one (or all — see below) of these words.
help.match: 'Any' = if at least one keyword is present → keep. 'All' = every keyword must be present.
help.caseSensitive: When off (recommended), 'NOI' and 'noi' are treated as the same word.
help.status: Active — runs on schedule. Paused — temporarily off but history kept. Archived — hidden from the main list.
help.useLlm: AI will score each finding's relevance to your topic (0-100). Detailed settings (model, prompt, score threshold, daily cost cap) are in the 'AI' tab.
help.lookBackDays: Skip articles older than the selected window (using their RSS publish date). Useful for fresh news only. 'Unlimited' accepts everything.
help.cleanupEnabled: When enabled, the N oldest findings of this bot are deleted automatically on the chosen day + hour — regardless of status. Disable if you prefer to clean only manually with the buttons below.
help.cleanupDay: Which day of the week the auto-cleanup runs. 'Daily' = every night.
help.cleanupHour: At which hour (Sofia time) the cleanup runs. Recommended at night (02:00-05:00) when traffic is lowest.
help.cleanupBatchSize: How many oldest findings to delete on each run. Example: 100 = from 320 findings → 220 remain (the 100 oldest by foundAt are deleted).
help.notificationEmails: Email addresses to receive a report after every run of this bot. Press Enter (or comma) after each address. Leave empty to use the system defaults.

bot.cleanupSummary: Auto cleanup: {{day}} at {{time}} EEST → {{count}} oldest findings will be deleted.

notifications.fallbackHint: System default emails will be used (CRAWLER_DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_EMAILS).

help.maxPages: For HTML sources: how many pagination pages to crawl (1 = first page only). The bot stops early if all items are already seen or older than the bot's 'How far back' setting. Useful for fetching historical results from search pages (e.g., /search?q=topic&page=1..10).

validation.robotsWarning: The site restricts bots in robots.txt — proceed at your own risk.
validation.neverValidated: Source has not been validated yet.

errorCode.NO_RSS_FOUND: No RSS feed found on this page.
errorCode.BLOCKED_PRIVATE_IP: Address points to a private network — blocked.

selectors.title: CSS selectors for HTML
selectors.help: Selectors tell the bot where articles live on the page. Example: 'article.news' picks every element with class news. Attributes use @, e.g. 'a@href' = the href attribute of the first link.
selectors.autoDetectedHint: These values were auto-detected from the page. You can keep them, refine them, or write your own — then click "Re-test".

card.foundAtTooltip: Source doesn't expose a machine-readable publish date — showing when the bot first saw the article.

deleteBot.title: Delete bot
deleteBot.message: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

deleteSource.title: Delete source
deleteSource.message: Are you sure you want to delete source "{{name}}"?

clearFindings.title: Clear findings
clearFindings.help: Removes all findings for this bot. Useful when you change keywords and want the bot to re-evaluate everything from scratch on the next run.
clearFindings.message: Are you sure you want to delete ALL findings for this bot? They will be re-evaluated on the next run.

master.label: Enable AI scoring with Claude
master.desc: When enabled, every new finding is sent to Claude for a 0-100 relevance score against the bot's topic. Below the threshold → auto-dismissed (if auto-dismiss is on). Per-bot only — doesn't affect other bots.

test.title: Test before enabling
test.desc: Send one article through AI with current settings. See exact prompt + response. Counts toward daily cost cap.

placeholder.extraInstructions: e.g. Ignore foreign-country articles unless about pensions. Score articles with concrete numbers higher.

help.minScore: Articles with a lower AI score → auto-dismissed (if the toggle below is on).
help.autoDismiss: When off: all articles stay as 'new', just get a score badge — you decide manually.
help.temperature: 0 = strict and stable (same input = same score). Higher = more varied scores.
help.maxTokens: Max tokens Claude can return. 300 is enough for score + 1-2 sentences of reasoning.
help.dailyCostCap: When reached, AI scoring stops for the day. New findings are saved without a score, nothing crashes. Resets at Sofia midnight.
help.systemPrompt: Core instructions sent every time. You can use {{bot_description}}, {{keywords}}, {{bot_name}} placeholders. Empty = use built-in default.
help.extraInstructions: Extra instructions appended to the system prompt. Add topic-specific tweaks here.

zone.title: Cleanup findings
zone.desc: Manual bulk operations. Auto-cleanup is configured in Edit → Auto cleanup of findings.

dismissed.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete ALL dismissed findings of this bot? This cannot be undone.

used.help: Deletes findings marked as 'Used' that are older than X months — to free space after long-running work.
used.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete used findings older than {{months}} months? This cannot be undone.

fromFinding.error: Couldn't load the finding. Start a new article with the blank form below.

banner.title: Started from a bot finding
banner.text: The fields below are pre-filled with a suggestion from the bot — title, description, image and a link back to the original. This is just a starting point. Read the original and write your own content to avoid plagiarism.
